author: WP14
summary: Alpha.1-era chapter on the optional CNA::Devices layer: build gate, wrapper map, camera, per-class platform support, overlap with CNA::Input, lifetimes and the callback boundary. The gate and overlap remain true; the file counts, the direct-SDL framing, MessageBox support and empty-list checks, the advisory FileDialog/SystemTray checks, the camera-subsystem gap and the CI claim are stale. Device-extension internals already held the service table; a new deep dive holds the user-facing contract and edges.

sections.heading: Camera: poll, do not wait for a callback

concepts.text: CNA::Devices is an SDL3 host-integration layer with no XNA or Windows Phone precedent.
tokens: no XNA or Windows Phone precedent
concepts.note: A layer over platform service interfaces; SDL3 is the only complete provider, not the layer itself.

concepts.text: CNA::Devices is absent from a default CNA build.
Both facts come before the API tour because code that compiles in a devices-enabled demo can otherwise look like an unconditional framework surface.
tokens: can otherwise look like an unconditional framework surface

concepts.text: CNA_DEVICES defaults to OFF.
The option gates 25 installed headers, 14 production sources and ten test files in modules/devices-ext.
tokens: 18 public headers, 10 sources and 10 test files
concepts.note: Recounted at TARGET: 18 headers, 10 sources, 10 test files, all wrapped in #ifdef CNA_DEVICES.

concepts.text: With the default setting the archive has no defined API symbols and its tests register no cases.
Camera, FileDialog and SystemTray do not throw at run time in a default build; they do not exist as C++ types.
tokens: do not exist as C++ types

concepts.text: The option does not gate Microsoft::Devices::Sensors.
tokens: The CNA_DEVICES option does not gate this module

concepts.text: The option's help text about device/sensor extensions is misleading because sensors are not gated.

target.evidence: CMakeLists.txt (option text "Enable CNA-specific device/sensor extensions beyond XNA 4.0 (battery, camera, clipboard, ...)")

concepts.text: Accelerometer, Gyroscope, Compass, Motion and VibrateController compile in every configuration while CNA::Devices is entirely conditional.
Sources using these types must be compiled with the definition CNA's targets propagate; hand-defining it without linking an enabled archive only postpones failure to link time.
tokens: only moves the failure to link time

concepts.text: The implemented classes are deliberately thin wrappers.
tokens: thin translations over the selected platform's service interfaces
concepts.note: They wrap platform service interfaces (IPlatformDialogs, IPlatformClipboard, ...), not SDL calls.

concepts.text: Clipboard gets, sets and probes clipboard text.
DisplayInfo exposes a window's display scale and safe interactive area.
Locale returns the preferred locale list.
MessageBox shows simple or multi-button native dialogs.
FileDialog opens file, save and directory choosers asynchronously.
tokens: file and folder dialogs take a callback and are asynchronous

concepts.text: SystemTray owns a tray icon and a flat callback-driven menu.
PowerInfo exposes host power state, percentage and remaining seconds.
SystemInfo reports logical CPU cores and physical RAM.
UrlLauncher forwards a URL to the platform.
tokens: forwards the string to the platform

concepts.text: Camera polls camera frames into a Texture2D.
The module has no TODO, NotImplemented or throw-placeholder tokens, but thin forwarding has behavioural edges.
MessageBox reports support unconditionally.
concepts.note: Support comes from the platform capability at TARGET.

concepts.text: MessageBox never parents the dialog to a window.
tokens: never parented to the game window

concepts.note: The SDL3 service refuses an empty list and the wrapper reports -1.

target.evidence: modules/devices-ext/src/FileDialog.cpp (Show gates on capability); SystemTray.cpp (constructor throws)

SystemTray exposes no usable icon object.

concepts.text: Camera chooses the first reported device, requests RGBA32 and closes/reports unsupported if another pixel format is negotiated.

concepts.note: A wrong negotiated format reports Lost at TARGET.

concepts.text: Permission state is re-read on every State query because a platform prompt can resolve long after construction.

concepts.section: Camera: poll, do not wait for a callback
concepts.text: TryAcquireFrame requires a destination texture with exactly the negotiated dimensions and returns false without modifying it if permission is not ready, dimensions mismatch or no fresh frame exists.

concepts.section: Camera: poll, do not wait for a callback
concepts.text: The production tree never initializes SDL's camera subsystem, so enumeration is empty and Camera settles in NotSupported unless the host starts it: an initialization gap, not a permission denial.
concepts.note: Positive evidence: Sdl3CameraProvider starts SDL_INIT_CAMERA once on first use (EnsureCameraSubsystem) and never quits it; its comment records the earlier empty-enumeration defect.

concepts.section: Camera: poll, do not wait for a callback
concepts.text: The backend's Lost and Closed states are unreachable.
tokens: is never returned by this wrapper
concepts.note: Lost is reachable (best effort); Closed is never returned.

concepts.text: SystemTray is desktop-only in SDL3; Android, iOS and Emscripten have no tray backend.
tokens: The system tray exists on the SDL3 platform
concepts.note: Also absent on Wayland and Win32 at TARGET.

concepts.text: FileDialog is not equivalent: SDL3 supplies an Android implementation.
tokens: an SDL fact not re-verified here
concepts.note: The CNA policy is verified; SDL's Android dialog is not.

concepts.text: Display scale and safe area depend on a real associated window.
Message boxes and URL launchers inherit whatever the host permits, even when support predicates are optimistic.
A namespace-level desktop-utilities label is useful orientation but wrong as a capability test.
Query the particular class, expect platform-threaded callbacks and keep a non-dialog fallback for sandboxed or web targets.
CNA::Devices Clipboard and PowerInfo duplicate the unconditional CNA::Input::Clipboard and CNA::Input::Power.
They were created on parallel workstreams and use type-incompatible enums despite wrapping the same call.
With CNA_DEVICES=OFF the Input versions are the only clipboard and host-battery APIs.
tokens: the CNA::Input versions are the only clipboard and host-battery APIs that exist

concepts.text: Input's Sensors is not a duplicate of Microsoft::Devices::Sensors: it is a stateless poll API returning raw vectors, while the WP7 classes are stateful objects with events, throttling and disposal.
InputDevices has no counterpart in CNA::Devices.
File dialogs, tray menus and camera permission cross native asynchronous boundaries; state captured by their callbacks must outlive the native operation.
UI callbacks should hand work back to the game thread before touching graphics state.
tokens: hand its work back to the game thread

concepts.text: Host shutdown must destroy these objects before global SDL teardown; the sensor and haptic side uses the explicit shutdown coordinator.
tokens: must be destroyed before the platform that created them
concepts.note: The ordering constraint is relative to the platform object that created the session or icon.

concepts.text: The file-dialog result trampoline and the tray-entry trampoline invoke C++ callbacks directly from SDL C callbacks with no try/catch, so handlers must not throw.
tokens: Keep dialog and tray handlers non-throwing

concepts.text: That differs from the sensor module, which catches and records exceptions at its corresponding boundary.
The ten devices-ext test sources exercise fake contracts only when the gate is on; in a default build they contribute zero tests.
tokens: they contribute no tests at all

concepts.text: A CI matrix that never configures CNA_DEVICES=ON proves neither the public types nor their platform forwarding.
concepts.note: At TARGET the devices presets and workflow do enable the option (canned-platform evidence).

concepts.text: Camera, dialogs, tray integration and permissions still need real-host validation beyond the unit tests.
tokens: still need validation on real hosts

issues.text: SDL3 dialog and tray trampolines call caller-supplied C++ callbacks from SDL C callbacks without try/catch; a throwing handler unwinds across a C boundary.
CNA::Devices::PowerInfo reads the platform power info separately for each property, so state, percentage and seconds can come from different instants.
SDL camera subsystem never initialized, leaving Camera NotSupported.
MessageBox dialogs are never parented and have no default/cancel button; SystemTray has no icon-image API; UrlLauncher does no validation.
The CNA_DEVICES option help text mentions sensors although sensors are always built (documentation wording).
Clipboard and Power exist twice (CNA::Input and CNA::Devices) with type-incompatible enums (architectural duplication).
CNA::Devices tests exercise canned platforms only; real dialogs, trays, cameras and permissions are unverified, and a default build compiles no devices-ext tests.
